title: CAISO: curtailment against midday prices
subtitle: Each point is a day, 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_curtailment_daily, iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-11.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). daily_renewable_report: Daily Renewable Report (curtailment and output). https://www.caiso.com/library/daily-renewable-reports. California ISO (CAISO). production_curtailments: Production and curtailments data (5-minute). https://www.caiso.com/library/production-curtailments-data. Retrieved 2026-10-11 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table caiso_curtailment_daily, data commit ceafacf8a4ad. Provenance tier: source (as the publisher published it, reshaped only).

California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_INTVL_LMP: OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-785-ER: Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-785-ER. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-905-CD: Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-905-CD. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_final: Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_prelim: Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Southwest Power Pool (SPP). RTBM-LMP-SL: RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute. https://portal.spp.org/pages/rtbm-lmp-by-location. Retrieved 2026-10-11 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices, data commit ceafacf8a4ad. Provenance tier: source (as the publisher published it, reshaped only).
facts: CAISO, 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09 (30 days): the most curtailment in a day was 18362.58 MWh on 2026-09-18, when the mean midday real-time price at TH_NP15_GEN-APND was 47.03 USD/MWh; the correlation of daily curtailment with the midday price over these days was 0.32.
Wind and solar curtailed, 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-09: 23155.08 MWh.

xAxis.name: Wind and solar curtailed, MWh per day

yAxis.name: Mean real-time price 10:00 to 16:00 Pacific, USD/MWh
